interpretation: Follow-up on previously evaluated questions, not an independent replication.
intervals: 95% nominal and Bonferroni-adjusted intervals for the three pairwise contrasts

matching.exception: If no match at the old length, start at the available original-text limit and shorten the three contexts together. Regenerate both original arms at that question's shorter matched length.
matching.order: Keep the original prefix. Try a contiguous continuation, then a paragraph break. Take exact original text from the same ranked passage list. Search cut points nearest the token boundary.

statistics.secondary_contrasts: CUAD and PubMedQA Bonferroni; other arms exploratory
